name: artifact-button-runtime-controls-commerce-boundary
description: Separates static CTA buttons from runtime-bound controls in an artifact with commerce-style JS product rendering: static source CTAs become native core/button, script-targeted controls are preserved as runtime islands, and JS-generated product add-to-cart controls are not guessed into native commerce blocks without a source product-card contract.

source_reference.notes: Round-2 button-family coverage: marketing CTA, lightbox/gallery control, and commerce placeholder whose product cards/add-to-cart buttons are rendered by client JS rather than present in the static DOM. The generic transformer can preserve runtime targets and native static CTAs, but needs an upstream product-scoped contract to map JS-generated add-to-cart controls to seeded product permalinks.

legacy_comparison.reason: Runtime target extraction and commerce-boundary diagnostics are current transformer contracts with no legacy comparison.
